description: Repairs r-fmt-2b/kill-after-close-fixed-update: the read of every row failed on the unreadable Decimal Fm. One fixed-width edit (UPDATE Fx SET Fb = 200 WHERE ID = 5, dbFailOnError). Writer A opens the database read/write, makes the mutation, closes the database (DBEngine alive) and signals; process B kills A at once (TerminateProcess, verified own worker), waits 0.5 s, keeps the frozen file, opens it read-only with DAO and reads the public state. Process-termination model only. Fx: ten rows on one small table (ID Long key; Byte Fb, Long Fl, Currency Fc, Date Ft, GUID Fg, a Text Vt and Decimal Fm made by ADO DDL as DECIMAL(28,0), so DAO can read it); row 8 is Null in Fb, Fl, Fc, Ft and Fm; elsewhere Fm = ID * 100.
retentionNote: Repair of r-fmt-2b/kill-after-close-fixed-update (Fm read through SQL). Participant a ends itself with TerminateSelf after Close, so the attempt seals Uncertain by design; participant b's answer is the evidence.
